theme_and_brand.description: A sophisticated, high-end digital identity dashboard matching the public landing page. Deep void-black backgrounds with champagne/gold accents, utilizing glass-morphism, subtle grain, and gold light sweeps to feel like an exclusive club rather than a generic SaaS tool. All app pages must enforce this dark mode permanently.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: The user explicitly requested 'Geist'/'Inter' typography. To prevent it from looking like standard 'AI slop', you MUST apply aggressive tracking and weight control. Use fluid typography.

headings.usage: Use font-light for large impressive headers (like 'Card Manager' or 'Studio'), and font-medium for card titles.

body.usage: Use text-white/70 or text-white/50 for descriptions to maintain strong contrast hierarchy against white text.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: OVERRIDE the root variables in index.css. Change both :root and .dark to use the dark theme variables. The entire dashboard must use the #050607 base.

visual_enhancers.grain: Keep the existing .grain-overlay in index.css but ensure it spans the entire dashboard background fixed at z-0.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl coupled with bg-white/5 and a 1px border-white/10 for headers, sticky tabs, and floating modals.
visual_enhancers.light_sweeps: For the 'Card Manager' items and 'Live Preview' phone bezel, add a subtle sweeping gradient on hover using CSS mask or framer-motion.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace default drop shadows with glowing ambient shadows for active states, e.g., shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(214,166,83,0.15)].

layouts.dashboard_container: A full-width layout with a sticky glassmorphic top header. Content should be constrained to max-w-7xl mx-auto with generous padding (p-6 md:p-12).
layouts.card_manager: Use the 'Bento' Mode A Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Cards should not be flat white; they must be deep dark (#0A0B0D) with delicate borders.
layouts.profile_editor: A 3-column structural layout for desktop (grid-cols-12 gap-8). Col 1 (span 2-3): Vertical tab navigation (sticky). Col 2 (span 5-6): The form inputs (Identity, Contact, etc.). Col 3 (span 4): Sticky live phone preview.
layouts.auth_pages: Centered glassmorphic card on a deep void background with a subtle gold radial gradient at the center behind the card. Use the dark texture image for the body background.

phone_preview.content: Render the exact premium signature look inside this bezel.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use default shadcn white cards. Customize the shadcn primitive components (Tabs, Card, Input) with these dark/gold Tailwind classes. DO NOT wrap components in basic white divs.

pages_to_redesign.login_register: Wrap the form in a glassmorphic container (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10). Use 'image_urls.auth_bg' as a subtle full-screen background image with a dark overlay.
pages_to_redesign.card_manager: Transform the list of profile cards into a high-end gallery. Each card should show its template badge, have an 'Edit' button that reveals on hover, and a 'View' / 'Analytics' quick action. The header actions (Industry Templates, Inbox, Scan Card) should be clean ghost/secondary buttons in a glass header.
pages_to_redesign.profile_editor: The multi-tab editor (Identity, Industry, Contact, Social, Services, Projects, Booking) is the crown jewel. Use the vertical tab layout. Add a prominent 'Publish' toggle in the header next to a 'Save Changes' button. Make the file upload (profile photo) feel premium (dashed border-white/20, hover glow).
pages_to_redesign.nfc_activation: Cinematic focus. A glowing gold NFC icon in the center, prompting the user to tap. Use framer-motion pulse effects.
pages_to_redesign.legal_policy: Clean, highly readable typography layout. Max-w-3xl, #0A0B0D background container, text-white/70 for body.
pages_to_redesign.modals_empty_states: Empty states should feature a delicate, low-opacity gold wireframe/icon, not a generic grey vector. Modals must be bg-[#0A0B0D] with border-white/10 and heavy backdrop blur.

motion.framer_motion: Use AnimatePresence for tab switching in the editor. Card manager items should stagger-fade in (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons must scale down slightly on tap (active:scale-95). Hovering over a card in the dashboard should slightly brighten its border (border-white/20).

auth_bg.description: Abstract yellow lines on dark background. Use for Login/Register background with opacity-20 and blend-mode-screen.

avatar_placeholder.description: Elegant professional man on dark background. Use as default avatar in the Live Phone Preview and Identity tab.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the gold text (#D6A653) on the #050607 background meets contrast ratios. For body text, use text-white/70 (which is #B3B3B3 equivalent) for high legibility.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D6A653] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#050607]).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic flat cards.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. DO NOT remove existing data-testids.
Do not use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast). Use shadcn components or sonner, but RESTYLE them with the dark/gold theme.

CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them. Always use a solid dark hex or heavy backdrop-blur with semi-transparent background.
